# Bayti (بيتي)

> UAE local marketplace connecting home-based sellers with buyers. Discover handmade products, home cooking, abayas, and unique gifts from sellers across the UAE.

Bayti is a bilingual (Arabic/English) marketplace focused on home-based sellers in the United Arab Emirates. Buyers browse products by category, message sellers directly, and place orders for local pickup or delivery. Sellers manage a shop profile, product catalog, and order pipeline.

## Key pages

- [Marketplace](https://www.bayti.ink/marketplace): Browse all products and sellers.
- [Categories](https://www.bayti.ink/categories): Browse by product category.
- [Sell on Bayti](https://www.bayti.ink/sell): Information for prospective sellers.
- [Seller application](https://www.bayti.ink/seller-apply): Apply to become a seller.

## Notes for crawlers and agents

- Content is rendered client-side (React SPA). Product and seller listings are fetched from the Bayti API at request time.
- The sitemap is at https://www.bayti.ink/sitemap.xml.
